The technique scales well with the number of threads.
On a 2.4 GHz Opteron NUMA workstation, scalability was tested on 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16 threads.
The slight change in slope at 8 threads corresponds to the use of local NUMA memory by two cores instead of one.
Overcomes GPU memory and bus bandwidth limitations.
*   **Limitations:** Performance degrades as the complexity of the volume increases (e.g., later timesteps in the heptane simulation).
